installer.intro: Connect the FM-1 by USB, in a MIDI-compatible browser: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera…
installer.warn: Do not unplug the USB cable while writing.
installer.editor: Felucca editor (the original firmware's: sequences, settings and backups)
installer.direct: Connect the USB cable directly to the computer.
installer.brick: If an install fails and the FM-1 no longer starts, recovering it needs a Transporter:
installer.beta: The Guru-600 has been tested on the FM-1: the sound, the sequencer, the saving and the installation work, and no fault is known to date. It replaces the official M-VAVE firmware, which you can put back at any time. Like all free software, it comes as it is, without warranty: back up your projects before installing.
installer.back: Get official FM-1 V15 from M-VAVE and select the unmodified FM-1.fwsc. The browser validates it locally; it is not sent to a server.
installer.stockGo: Back up and return to official V15
installer.stockBackup: Current music, saved music, sound banks, samples, the P600 places and settings are saved first. To restore an archive later, reinstall Guru-600 and use the editor.
installer.stockRecovery: Resume an interrupted update: I already saved a complete backup to this computer
installer.stockConfirm: Has the complete backup file been saved to this computer? Continue to return to official V15. Official V15 cannot open Guru-600 music.
installer.stockNeedBackup: An update loader cannot export a backup. Only select resume if you already saved a complete backup.
installer.stockUnsupported: This firmware does not support complete backups. Install the current Guru-600 first.
installer.nomidi: This browser cannot do it. Open the page in a MIDI-compatible browser: Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera…
installer.stopped: Stopped. Replug the USB cable and press Install again.
installer.denied: MIDI (SysEx) access was not allowed. Allow MIDI in the site settings (address bar) and press Install again.
installer.notfound: FM-1 not found. Check the USB cable (a data cable), close other apps that use MIDI, and press Install again.
installer.model: The connected device is not an FM-1.
installer.lost: The USB connection was lost. Replug it and press Install again.
installer.noloader: The FM-1 in update mode was not found. Replug the USB cable and press Install again (it stays in update mode until it is finished).
installer.noreturn: The FM-1 did not come back. Power-cycle it.
installer.mismatch: Written, but the FM-1 reports another version:
installer.badpkg: The file to install is damaged. Reload the page.
installer.leave: Writing. Do not close the page.
installer.send: Send Prophet-600 sounds (.syx) to the FM-1
installer.title: Install Guru-600 on the M-VAVE FM-1
installer.credit: Guru-600 by Marc Massé, based on Felucca by Leo Kuroshita.
installer.feedback: The Guru-600 is a free project, and it can always evolve. An idea for a feature or an improvement, or a bug: write to us at guru600fm1@gmail.com or on GitHub (Issues for bugs, Discussions for ideas):
installer.geditor: Guru-600 editor: the whole FM-1 on the computer, the P600 sounds included (its guide is linked from it)

sender.sub: Send Prophet-600 sounds (.syx) to your FM-1 running Guru-600. They stay in the FM-1, even after it is switched off.
sender.h1: Plug the FM-1 into this computer with a USB data cable and switch it on. Use Chrome, Edge or another Chrome-based browser (Brave, Opera…), and allow MIDI (SysEx) access when the browser asks.
sender.h2: A Prophet-600 .syx file: an original Sequential program dump, or a GliGli firmware patch file. One file can hold one sound or a whole bank of 100.
sender.h3: Each sound goes to the place you type (1 to 255, as numbered in PRESETS). It replaces the built-in sound of that place until RESET SOUNDS. Up to 55 sounds can be sent in all.
sender.name: Sound
sender.h4: Forget every sent or saved sound: the 255 built-in sounds come back. (The same as MENU > SYSTEM > RESET SOUNDS on the FM-1.)
sender.sure: Forget every sent or saved sound and restore the 255 original sounds?
sender.nomidi: This browser has no Web MIDI. Use Chrome, Edge or another Chrome-based browser (Brave, Opera…).
sender.denied: MIDI (SysEx) access was not allowed. Allow it in the site settings and try again.
sender.noport: No MIDI output found. Check the USB cable (a data cable) and that the FM-1 is on.
sender.none: No Prophet-600 sound in this file.
sender.done: Done. The sounds are in the FM-1's PRESETS list.
sender.h5: Get sounds from the FM-1 into a .syx file, in the Prophet-600's own format: one place, the sounds you saved or imported, or all 255 places.
sender.getkept: Get the saved and imported sounds
sender.got: sounds saved in the file (Downloads folder).
sender.noinput: The FM-1 does not answer. Check that it runs Guru-600 and is connected by USB, then press Connect again.
sender.nokept: No saved or imported sound on the FM-1.
